Wait there are two labels: "滥伐林木" and "盗伐林木". Need to differentiate. In Chinese criminal law, there is crime of "非法采伐、毁坏森林资源罪" (illegal logging). The term used in examples: "滥伐林木" (overcutting) and "盗伐林木" (illegal logging of forest). Which one fits? The example with "庞某" (illegal without permit) got "滥伐林木".
